BienvenueBeta.merci: Thank you for agreeing to test the platform. Monumia finds the funding schemes your monument may qualify for and supports you in putting the applications together.
BienvenueBeta.rodage: It is still being fine-tuned: a screen that loses you, a missing scheme, a figure that surprises you; everything you notice along the way helps us improve it.
BienvenueBeta.bugTitre: A bug, an idea, a question?
BienvenueBeta.bugTexte: Write to us with this button, from any page. You can capture the screen and annotate it: we receive your message along with the page you were on.

Disclaimer.message: Eligibility estimated on the basis of the information provided. Each organisation decides on the final award of funding. Monumia does not guarantee that funding will be obtained.

AuthLayout.pitch: Identify the grants, tax deductions and patronage schemes available for your historic monuments.
